Capability and readiness forecast for GATE15 through GATE40. Creates no contract, no authority and no START; records only what already exists and what is normally absent before a Gate begins.

The exact set of governance-suite failure identities already failing at this baseline HEAD, with root-cause classes and the recomputed load-bearing checks that justify classifying them unrelated, so future Gates compare identities rather than counts.

Positive and hostile coverage for the pre-execution check: fail-closed on unknown gate, detection of vanished or drifted prior research, systemic classification of a missing primitive, and proof that no verdict is hardcoded and nothing is written inside the repository.
